name: Convertible JPY Token
oneLiner: CJPY is Yamato's decentralized Japanese yen stablecoin, minted from overcollateralized ETH pledges via Liquity-v1-style permissionless CDPs.
collateral: ETH only; 130% minimum collateralization ratio at issuance (110% MCR for liquidation); one-time borrowing fee with no accrued interest
pegMechanism: Overcollateralized ETH CDPs (pledges) with game-theory peg maintenance: (1) hard floor via on-chain redemption of 1 CJPY for 1 JPY worth of ETH from the riskiest pledge; (2) subrogation mechanism uses accumulated protocol fees to automatically repay positions below 100% health rate; (3) non-forced liquidation where any user can redeem debt positions below 130% using market-purchased CJPY

oracleRisk.summary: Yamato's sole ETH pledge branch derives ETH/JPY from Chainlink ETH/USD and JPY/USD feeds and reverts when either component is broken or stale; there is no alternate provider fallback in the live PriceFeedV3 path.

branchApplicability.rationale: The live Yamato deployment exposes one ETH-backed CJPY pledge market. Its composite oracle, 130% minimum collateral ratio, permissionless redemption path, reserve-funded residual-debt sweep, and pause behavior form one collateral-liquidation branch.

branches.label: Yamato ETH pledges
branches.summary: The sole CJPY debt branch prices ETH in JPY from two Chainlink components and permits under-MCR pledge redemption, with zero-collateral residual debt routed to the Sweep Reserve process.

feeds.path: Chainlink ETH/USD divided by Chainlink JPY/USD -> Yamato PriceFeedV3 -> ETH pledge collateral ratio

branches.fallbackBehavior: PriceFeedV3 rejects non-positive, malformed, future-dated, or unavailable Chainlink responses. It reverts when ETH/USD is older than one hour or JPY/USD is older than 24 hours; the deployed V3 path has no alternate-provider fallback.

collateralParameters.note: The live Yamato proxy returned MCR = 130 at Ethereum block 25530969. CJPY debt is backed only by native ETH pledges.

branches.liquidationMechanism: Any caller holding CJPY can invoke Yamato's redemption path against the lowest-collateralized pledges below the 130% MCR. The contracts contain no time-based waiting gate before an eligible pledge can be redeemed.
branches.backstop: Redemption burns the caller's CJPY against pledge debt and transfers the corresponding ETH. If a pledge reaches zero collateral with debt remaining, the permissionless sweep process repays that debt from the protocol Sweep Reserve, subject to available reserve balance.
branches.shutdownOrBadDebtBehavior: Broken or stale Chainlink input makes PriceFeedV3 revert rather than use an alternate feed. Yamato's pause guard stops user actions when governance pauses the protocol; zero-collateral residual debt remains queued for reserve-funded sweeping and cannot be swept when the Sweep Reserve is empty.

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: At Ethereum block 25534914, the verified non-proxy CJPY ABI exposes mint(address,uint256), burn(address,uint256), revokeGovernance(), setCurrencyOS(address), and standard ERC-20 functions; it has no blacklist, freeze, pause, or transfer-restriction function. The pinned Currency source gates mint and burn to CurrencyOS and lets its private governance address replace CurrencyOS, but the live ABI exposes neither the private governance nor currencyOS value. The pinned CurrencyOS and Yamato sources describe a conditional architecture in which registered Yamato contracts can call burnCurrency(to, amount) and Yamato module routing and pause state are governance-controlled. At the same block, the live Yamato UUPS proxy resolved to implementation 0x0bfa59f9fbe9565c240cd64311c86e90e59a4838 and governance() returned 0x0b0a167a0b6800207c89544d2ebdc98dcdd33bec, but that observation cannot bind the Safe to CJPY's current private CurrencyOS route. Retain possible only for this source-level conditional, not as evidence of an active holder blacklist, freeze, or current mutable CJPY control path.

mintAuthority.summary: CJPY is minted permissionlessly from Yamato's Liquity-v1-style ETH pledges (130% MCR, one-time fee, no interest). The Yamato contract is a UUPS proxy (ERC1967Proxy) pointing to YamatoV4 implementation; upgrade authority (onlyGovernance) is held by a 2-of-4 Gnosis Safe at 0x0b0a167a0b6800207c89544d2ebdc98dcdd33bec with no modules. CJPY token is non-upgradeable with no owner; its own private governance variable has been permanently renounced (revokeGovernance), so its CurrencyOS pointer is fixed. CurrencyOS itself (which coordinates minting) is a separate UUPS proxy whose upgrade authority resolves to the same 2-of-4 Safe.

controls.label: Yamato pledge contract (ETH CDP mint)
controls.capDescription: Mint bounded by the 130% minimum collateralization ratio on ETH pledges, with redemption-based peg defense.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295201, the Yamato proxy (0x02Fe72b2E9fF717EbF3049333B184E9Cd984f257) has EIP-1967 impl slot pointing to YamatoV4 (0x0bfa59f9fbe9565c240cd64311c86e90e59a4838, 29684 bytes); proxy admin slot = 0x0 (UUPS pattern). Users mint CJPY by overcollateralizing ETH at 130% MCR.

controls.label: Yamato governance Safe (upgrade + parameter authority)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295201, governance() on the Yamato proxy returns 0x0b0a167a0b6800207c89544d2ebdc98dcdd33bec (GnosisSafeProxy); getOwners() = 4 addresses; getThreshold() = 2; getModulesPaginated returns empty array (next=sentinel, length=0). YamatoV4 source confirms onlyGovernance modifier gates upgrades and parameter changes.

controls.label: CJPY token private governance (renounced)
controls.capDescription: The pinned Currency.sol source declares a private `governance` slot that alone can call setCurrencyOS(); it exposes no public getter.
controls.evidence: Currency.sol declares `address currencyOS` then `address governance` as its own storage variables, placed after ERC20Permit's inherited layout (_balances, _allowances, _totalSupply, _name, _symbol, _nonces occupy slots 0-5). Direct eth_getStorageAt reads on the CJPY token at Ethereum block 25579969 confirm this: slot 2 held totalSupply, slots 3/4 held the packed name/symbol strings, slot 6 (currencyOS) held 0x000000000000000000000000e69c6bf0a6ea2f12abe054988a3e2091a8a3784f, and slot 7 (governance) read all-zero. Since Currency.sol's only governance-mutating function is revokeGovernance() (no replacement setter exists), a zero value means governance has been permanently renounced: setCurrencyOS() can no longer be called by anyone, so the token's currencyOS pointer (0xe69C6Bf0A6eA2F12aBE054988A3e2091a8a3784f) is now fixed.

controls.label: CurrencyOS UUPS governance (Yamato Safe)
controls.capDescription: CurrencyOS.addYamato/setDeps (registering new Yamato mint sources) and its UUPS _authorizeUpgrade are both gated onlyGovernance.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25579969, CurrencyOS 0xe69C6Bf0A6eA2F12aBE054988A3e2091a8a3784f is a UUPS proxy (EIP-1967 admin slot = 0x0, implementation = 0x811cE73639A05f436a56ea71480cd921a4039542) whose public governance() returns 0x0b0a167a0b6800207c89544d2ebdc98dcdd33bec — the same 2-of-4 Safe already resolved as the Yamato pledge contract's governance. The pinned UUPSBase source confirms _authorizeUpgrade and the onlyGovernance modifier gate both upgrades and CurrencyOS's addYamato/setDeps functions, with a 2-phase setGovernance/acceptGovernance transfer and a revokeGovernance option available to that Safe.

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295201: Yamato proxy (0x02Fe72b2E9fF717EbF3049333B184E9Cd984f257) is an ERC1967Proxy (UUPS) pointing to YamatoV4 impl (0x0bfa59f9fbe9565c240cd64311c86e90e59a4838); proxy admin EIP-1967 slot = 0x0 (UUPS). governance() returns 0x0b0a167a0b6800207c89544d2ebdc98dcdd33bec (GnosisSafeProxy, 4 owners, threshold 2, no modules). CJPY token (0x1cfa5641c01406ab8ac350ded7d735ec41298372): EIP-1967 proxy admin slot = 0x0, owner() reverts — immutable non-upgradeable token. Follow-up 2026-07-20: the Yamato pledge contract 0x02Fe72b2E9fF717EbF3049333B184E9Cd984f257 exposes MCR()=130 and feePool() but no aggregate supply cap or debt ceiling getter; CJPY minting is bounded only by per-vault ETH collateral at the MCR, so the economic cap semantics are unbounded. Follow-up 2026-07-21: the CJPY token's own private governance/CurrencyOS route (previously unbound to the Safe) is now resolved by direct storage read — governance slot 7 is all-zero (permanently renounced via revokeGovernance(), no replacement setter exists), so the token's currencyOS pointer (0xe69C6Bf0A6eA2F12aBE054988A3e2091a8a3784f) is fixed. CurrencyOS is a separate UUPS proxy whose public governance() resolves to the same 2-of-4 Yamato Safe (0x0b0a167a0b6800207c89544d2ebdc98dcdd33bec), which is also the sole authority for addYamato/setDeps and CurrencyOS upgrades.

reserves.name: ETH
reserves.issuerOrObligor: Ethereum network and Yamato CDP system

reserveReview.reviewer: SONG Safety Score V9 reserve review
reserveReview.rationale: Yamato documents CJPY as minted against ETH pledges with a 130% minimum collateral ratio. The tracked reserve envelope is therefore the sole ETH collateral category; live position weights change onchain and are not represented as a static allocation.
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: No reserve exposure outside ETH pledges is documented; current individual pledge positions are dynamic.

nonLinkDispositions.rationale: Native ETH collateral is an external asset rather than a tracked stablecoin dependency.

providers.name: Yamato Pool contract 0x9C1F0E3D4BD4A513721C028e1D4610CD17745f0B (collateral holding) and CjpyOS pledge registry via Yamato proxy 0x02Fe72b2E9fF717EbF3049333B184E9Cd984f257

custodyProfile.reviewer: Kimi P2 reserve cohort rc-2 (lead buidl-blackrock)
custodyProfile.uncertainty: All ETH collateral is pooled in the Yamato Pool contract with per-user pledges recorded in CjpyOS; there is no custodian, and the protocol does not lend out collateral by design. The contracts are UUPS-upgradeable by the DeFiGeek Community DAO. Legal segregation and bankruptcy-remoteness terms do not apply to contract custody; on-chain state (about 675.6 ETH pooled at 2026-07-19) is directly readable.
